# Theprescription

> AI-Powered Clinical Prescription & Doctor Handwriting Deciphering Assistant

Theprescription is an educational healthcare intelligence platform that assists patients, caregivers, and pharmacists in deciphering handwritten doctor prescriptions, identifying generic chemical equivalents, clarifying Latin dosing shorthand, and understanding circadian medication intervals.

## Core Resources
- [Prescription Decipherer](https://www.theprescription.in/): Core OCR vision engine for interpreting cursive physician handwriting and prescription notes.
- [Medicine & Generic Salt Directory](https://www.theprescription.in/#lookup): Comprehensive clinical index of 5,000+ brand medications, active generic pharmaceutical salts, dosage forms, and indications.
- [Medical Abbreviations Dictionary](https://www.theprescription.in/#abbreviations): Decoded Latin prescription notation including 1-0-1, OD, BD, TDS, AC, PC, SOS, HS, and STAT.
- [Clinical Health Blog](https://www.theprescription.in/#blog): 17 evidence-based clinical articles on medication literacy, pediatric dosing, drug-food interactions, and chronotherapy.
- [Medical FAQs](https://www.theprescription.in/#faq): 62 physician-verified answers covering storage protocols, missed doses, and polypharmacy safety.
- [Clinical Mission & Principles](https://www.theprescription.in/#about): Mission statement, privacy architecture, and zero-retention health data philosophy.
- [Medical Disclaimer](https://www.theprescription.in/#disclaimer): Critical safety notice and guidance on consulting licensed healthcare professionals.
